استؤمنا (form X)
# اُسْتُؤْمِنَا (ustuʔminā) /us.tuʔ.mi.naː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَأْمَنَ (istaʔmana)
# اُسْتُؤْمِنَّا (ustuʔminnā) /us.tuʔ.min.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَأْمَنَ (istaʔmana)
